1.explanation:
1. packages/react/src/components/DataTable/TableBatchActions.js: This is the main component responsible for rendering the batch actions bar, including the 'items selected' text. To add a 'Select all' button next to this text, this file will need to be updated to render the new button and handle its logic.
2. packages/react/src/components/DataTable/DataTable.tsx: This is the core data table component that manages selection logic, including selecting all rows. To support selecting all items across all pages (not just the current page), the selection logic here will need to be updated to handle the new 'Select all' action and propagate the selection state accordingly.

Other files such as tests and stories may need updates for coverage and documentation, but the above two are the key files for implementing the feature.
1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario is a feature request to add a 'Select all' button to the TableBatchActions component in a data table. This button should allow users to select all items across all pages, not just the current page, similar to the behavior seen in Gmail. The provided images illustrate the desired UI: a 'Select all' button next to the 'items selected' text in the batch actions bar, and an example from Gmail where a link allows selecting all conversations across all pages.
